description: Recommendations — varied group types, seasons, and objectives

requests.notes: Vary group: solo first-timer in summer, family with young kids in October, two adults visiting for a long weekend wanting two hikes. Do not recommend severe weather exposure trails for beginners without explicit caveats.
Vary objective: something new after doing the Presidentials, best hike for peak fall foliage above treeline, a challenging solo day. Include at least one with above-treeline weather exposure.
Experienced hiker looking for something harder or more interesting. One winter objective, one technical summer day with fall-risk interest. Terse recommendations.
